performance_question: Does spreading the same 24 fixed-reader AIPerf Mooncake clients over three instead of two vCluster CPU nodes break the observed 8.25k RPS plateau of one Envoy generic-with-callouts gateway?
comparison_limit: The two-node 24-client point is from a prior series; it is contextual only. A higher clean absolute rate would disprove 8.25k RPS as a hard gateway ceiling, but no direct gain percentage should be attributed without a same-series placement bridge.
user_workload_note: Gateway-only mocker campaign outside the DGD recipe-optimization workload contract; this plan and the frozen trace define the run.

trace.mmap_cache: require HIT on every client; no measured-phase tokenizer or composer work

instrument.version_selection: Reference-reproduction exception retaining pinned AIPerf 0.12.0 with explicit cursor-free mmap overlay

placement.rationale: The three schedulable nodes do not host this campaign's gateway, selector, preprocessor, or synthetic-worker pods. They host separate-namespace AIPerf or worker pods, so this is not a fully isolated client allocation. A fourth apparently empty node was excluded because it is cordoned; the guard refused it before creating any Job.
placement.occupancy_policy: Record live competing pods before and after. Do not mutate unrelated namespaces. Treat neighbor changes as a limitation unless synchronized time-series proves effect.

evidence_limit: Summary-level exports lack request-ID audit. Other-namespace occupancy is not controlled. This is a mocker capacity diagnostic, not a production-GPU or promotion claim.
